question: Who has been appointed as the 51st Chief Justice of India by Chief Justice D.Y. Chandrachud?
question_hi: मुख्य न्यायाधीश डी वाई चंद्रचूड़ ने भारत के 51वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया है?
solution:
The correct answer is Justice Sanjiv Khanna

In News

  • Chief Justice of India (CJI) Dhananjaya Y Chandrachud has initiated the process for his successor by recommending Justice Sanjiv Khanna to the Union government.

Confusion Points

  • The current Chief Justice of India (as of September 2025) is BR Gavai.

Key Points

  • Justice Khanna, the Supreme Court's senior-most judge, is next in line based on seniority.
  • He will be eligible to assume the position of CJI upon Chandrachud's retirement on November 10, 2024.
  • Justice Khanna is expected to serve as CJI for about six months until his retirement on May 13, 2025.
  • The recommendation process was prompted by a letter from the central government, requesting the current CJI to name his successor.

Additional Information

  • On October 12, the law ministry typically sends a letter to the CJI a little over a month before their retirement to begin this process.
  • The incumbent CJI responds with a recommendation, which is then reviewed by the government.
  • According to the memorandum of procedure (MoP) governing judicial appointments, the most senior judge of the Supreme Court deemed fit should be appointed as CJI.
  • Following the recommendation from CJI Chandrachud, the government is expected to issue a notification to officially appoint Justice Khanna as the next CJI effective November 11, 2024.

question: Which country set a new T20I world record for the highest-ever score in a T20 International match?
question_hi: किस देश ने T20 अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मैच में अब तक के सर्वोच्च स्कोर का नया T20 विश्व रिकॉर्ड बनाया?
solution:
The correct answer is Zimbabwe.

In News

  • Zimbabwe set a new T20I world record by scoring 344 runs against Gambia in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Sub-Regional Africa Qualifier, surpassing Nepal's previous record of 314 runs.

Key Points

  • Sikandar Raza led Zimbabwe's innings with an unbeaten 133 off 43 balls, hitting 15 sixes and 7 fours.
  • Raza's century marked the first T20I century by a Zimbabwean player.
  • This inning also tied Raza for the second-fastest century in T20I history.

Additional Information

  • Zimbabwe's remarkable performance broke the previous record held by Nepal, who scored 314 runs.
  • The ICC Men's T20 World Cup Sub-Regional Africa Qualifier saw this record-breaking performance by Zimbabwe.

question: Anaerobic respiration in the muscle cell results in the accumulation of
question_hi: पेशी कोशिका में अवायवीय श्वसन के परिणामस्वरूप __________ का संचय होता है।
solution:
The correct answer is Lactic acid.

Key Points

  • Cellular respiration is a breakdown of a complex molecule into simpler forms and also results in the release of energy.
    • In the presence of oxygen aerobic respiration occurs.
    • In the absence of oxygen anaerobic respiration occurs.
    • Anaerobic respiration in our body muscles produces Lactic acid and energy.
    • In the absence of oxygen, pyruvate is converted to form lactic acid, and energy is released.
    • It leads to muscle cramps and pain.

question: In India, National Statistics Day is celebrated on ______.
question_hi: भारत में, राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी दिवस ______ को मनाया जाता है।
solution:
The correct answer is 29th June.

Key Points

  • Every year 29 June is celebrated as National Statistics Day in India.
  • The day is celebrated in honour of the remarkable contribution of the famous Indian scientist and statistician PC Mahalanobis in the field of economic planning and statistical development.
  • Professor Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis is considered the father of Indian statistics.
  • The National Statistics Day was first celebrated on 29th June 2007.
  • The key contribution of PC Mahalanobis is known as "Mahalanobis distance'.
  • The formula is used to find the distance between a point and a distribution, based on measurements in multiple dimensions.
  • It is widely used in the field of cluster analysis and classification.

question: Who is the founder of Samkhya school of philosophy?
question_hi: सांख्य दर्शनशास्त्र के संस्थापक कौन हैं?
solution:
The correct answer is Kapila.

Key Points

  • Sage Kapila is traditionally known as a founder of the Samkhya school.
  • Samkhya refers to the philosophical school in Hinduism based on systematic enumeration and rational examination. 
  • Samkhya is one of the most prominent and one of the oldest of Indian philosophies.
  • Based on the Upanishads, there are two schools of philosophy developed in India:
    • Samkhya)
    • Vedanta.
  • The Samkhya philosophy combines the basic doctrines of Samkhya and Yoga. However, it should be remembered that the Samkhya represents the theory and Yoga represents the application or the practical aspects.

Additional Information

  • Gautama Muni is the founder of Nyaya Philosophy. 
  • The Mimamsa Sutra or the Purva Mimamsa Sutras, written by Rishi Jaimini is one of the most important ancient Hindu philosophical texts.
  • Yoga Sutras are considered to serve as the basis of yogic techniques.
  • Maharishi Patanjali is also known as "The Father of Yoga".
  • He had compiled 195 sutras, which serve as a framework for integrating Yoga into the daily routine and leading an ethical life.

question:
Consider the following pairs:

Puppet State
1. Bommalattam Tamil Nadu
2. Ravanchhaya Bihar
3. Putul Nauch Karnataka

Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित युग्मों पर विचार कीजिए:

कठपुतली राज्य
1. बोम्मालट्टम तमिलनाडु
2. रावणछाया बिहार
3. पुतुल नाच कर्नाटक

ऊपर दिए गए युग्मों में से कौन-सा/से सही सुमेलित है/हैं?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1.

Key Points

Indian Puppetry

  • Puppetry has long been of interest in India, both for entertainment and educational purposes.
  • The excavation sites at Harappa and Mohenjodaro have yielded puppets with sockets attached to them, which suggest the presence of puppetry as an art form even during those days. 
  • A large variety of puppetry traditions have developed in various parts of India, each with its own distinct form of puppets.
  • Bommalattam
    • ​It is the puppetry indigenous to the region of Tamil Nadu. Hence, pair 1 is correctly matched.
    • It combines features of rod and string puppetry.
    • The strings are attached to an iron ring which is worn by the puppeteer on his head.
    • The Bommalattam puppets are the largest and heaviest marionettes found in India, with some of them as large as 4.5 ft in height and 10 kg in weight.
  • Ravanchhaya
    • ​It is the most theatrical shadow puppetry and is a popular form of entertainment in the Odisha region. Hence, pair 2 is not correctly matched.
    • The puppets are made of deerskin and depict bold and dramatic postures.
    • They do not have any joints attached to them, making it a more complex art.
    • The use of non-human puppets such as trees and animals is common.
    • The Ravanchhaya artists are extremely well trained in their art creating a lyrical and sensitive theatrical narration.
  • Putul Nauch
    • It is the traditional rod puppet dance of the Bengal-Odisha-Assam Region. Hence, pair 3 is not correctly matched.
    • The figures are generally three to four ft. high and dressed as characters of Jatra.
    • They generally have three joints – at the neck and at the shoulders.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

Key Points

भारतीय कठपुतली

  • मनोरंजन और शैक्षिक दोनों उद्देश्यों के लिए कठपुतली लंबे समय से भारत में रुचि का विषय रही है।
  • हड़प्पा और मोहनजोदड़ो के उत्खनन स्थलों से कठपुतलियाँ जुड़ी हुई हैं, जो उनसे जुड़ी हुई हैं, जो उन दिनों भी एक कला के रूप में कठपुतली की उपस्थिति का सुझाव देती हैं। 
  • भारत के विभिन्न हिस्सों में कठपुतली परंपराओं की एक विशाल विविधता विकसित हुई है, प्रत्येक कठपुतली के अपने अलग रूप के साथ।
  • बोम्मालट्टम
    • यह तमिलनाडु के क्षेत्र के लिए स्वदेशी कठपुतली है। अत: युग्म 1 सही सुमेलित है।
    • यह छड़ और तार कठपुतली की विशेषताओं को जोड़ती है।
    • तार एक लोहे के छल्ले से जुड़े होते हैं जिसे कठपुतली के सिर पर पहनाया गया होता है।
    • बोम्मालात्तम कठपुतली भारत में पाए जाने वाले सबसे बड़े और सबसे भारी कठपुतली हैं, जिनमें से कुछ की ऊंचाई 4.5 फीट और वजन 10 किलोग्राम होता है।
  • रावणछाया
    • यह सबसे नाटकीय छाया कठपुतली है और ओडिशा क्षेत्र में मनोरंजन का एक लोकप्रिय रूप है। अत: युग्म 2 सही सुमेलित नहीं है।
    • कठपुतलियाँ मृग की खाल से बनी होती हैं और बोल्ड और नाटकीय मुद्राओं को दर्शाती हैं।
    • उनके पास कोई जोड़ नहीं है, जो इसे और अधिक जटिल कला बनाता है।
    • गैर-मानव कठपुतलियों जैसे पेड़ और जानवरों का उपयोग आम है।
    • रावणछाया कलाकार अपनी कला में एक गेय और संवेदनशील नाट्य कथा का निर्माण करने में बहुत अच्छी तरह से प्रशिक्षित हैं।
  • पुतुल नाच
    • यह  बंगाल-ओडिशा-असम क्षेत्र का पारंपरिक रॉड कठपुतली नृत्य है। अत: युग्म 3 सुमेलित नहीं है।
    • आकृतियाँ सामान्यतः तीन से चार फुट ऊँची होती हैं और जात्रा के पात्रों के रूप में तैयार की जाती हैं।
    • उनके आम तौर पर तीन जोड़ - गर्दन पर और कंधों पर  होते हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT a programming language?

solution:
The correct answer is Linux.

Key Points

  • Linux is an operating system, not a programming language.
  • It was created by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
  • Linux is widely used in servers, desktops, and embedded systems.
  • It is known for its security, stability, and flexibility.

Additional Information

  • Java:
    • Java is a high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language that is designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible.
    • It was developed by James Gosling at Sun Microsystems and released in 1995.
    • Java applications are typically compiled to bytecode that can run on any Java virtual machine (JVM) regardless of the underlying computer architecture.
    • It is widely used for building enterprise-scale applications, Android apps, and web applications.
  • C#:
    • C# (pronounced "C-sharp") is a modern, object-oriented, and type-safe programming language.
    • It was developed by Microsoft as part of its .NET initiative and was approved by the European Computer Manufacturers Association (ECMA) and International Standards Organization (ISO).
    • C# is used for developing a wide range of applications, from web and mobile apps to games and enterprise software.
    • It is known for its simplicity, modern syntax, and comprehensive .NET framework support.
  • Python:
    • Python is an interpreted, high-level, and general-purpose programming language.
    • It was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
    • Python's design philosophy emphasizes code readability with its notable use of significant whitespace.
    • It is widely used for web development, data analysis, artificial intelligence, scientific computing, and more.
  • Linux:
    • Linux is a family of open-source Unix-like operating systems based on the Linux kernel.
    • It was first released by Linus Torvalds on September 17, 1991.
    • Linux is typically packaged in a Linux distribution, which includes the kernel and supporting system software and libraries.
    • Popular Linux distributions include Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, and Red Hat.

  • लिनक्स:
    • लिनक्स लिनक्स कर्नेल पर आधारित ओपन-सोर्स यूनिक्स-जैसे ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम का एक परिवार है।

question: Who were awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry in 2024 for their contributions to protein structure prediction?
question_hi: 2024 में प्रोटीन संरचना की भविष्यवाणी में उनके योगदान के लिए रसायन विज्ञान के लिए नोबेल पुरस्कार किसे दिया गया था?
options: Moungi G. Bawendi and Louis E. Brus
David Baker, Demis Hassabis, and John M. Jumper

डेविड बेकर, डेमीस हसबीस और जॉन एम. जम्पर
solution:
The correct answer is David Baker, Demis Hassabis, and John M. Jumper.

In News

  • The Nobel Prize for Chemistry 2024 was awarded to David Baker “for computational protein design” and Demis Hassabis and John M. Jumper “for protein structure prediction.”

Key Points

  • In 2023, the Nobel Prize for Chemistry was awarded to Moungi G. Bawendi, Louis E. Brus, and Alexei I. Ekimov for their work on quantum dots.
  • The Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine 2024 was awarded to Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for the discovery of microRNA and its role in gene regulation.
  • The Nobel Prize for Physics 2024 was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for their work on machine learning with artificial neural networks.
  • The Nobel Prizes carry a cash award of 10 million Swedish kronor (nearly $900,000) and will be awarded on December 10, 2024.

Additional Information

question: Which memory unit has the fastest access time?
question_hi: कौन सी मेमोरी यूनिट में सबसे तेज़ एक्सेस टाइम होता है?
solution:
The correct answer is Cache Memory.

Key Points

  • Cache Memory is a small-sized type of volatile computer memory that provides high-speed data access to the processor and improves the overall speed and performance of the computer.
  • It is the fastest memory available and is typically used to store frequently accessed data and instructions so that the CPU can access them more quickly.
  • Cache memory is located close to the CPU, usually on the CPU chip itself or on a separate chip that has a direct connection to the CPU, which helps in reducing the time taken to access data.

Additional Information

  • Hard Disk Drive (HDD) is a traditional storage device that uses spinning disks to read/write data. It has a much slower access time compared to cache memory and is primarily used for long-term storage.
  • Random Access Memory (RAM) is a type of volatile memory used to store data that is actively being used or processed by the CPU. It is faster than HDD and SSD but slower than cache memory.
  • Solid State Drive (SSD) is a storage device that uses flash memory to store data. It is faster than HDD but still slower compared to cache memory and RAM. SSDs are more reliable and have quicker access times than HDDs.

question: The unit "hertz" is the SI unit of the physical quantity:
question_hi: "हर्ट्ज" निम्नलिखित में से किस भौतिक राशि का SI मात्रक है?
solution:
The correct answer is Frequency.

Explanation:

  • Frequency: The number of vibrations at which sound waves travel per second is called the frequency of the sound wave.
    • It is denoted by f.
    • The SI unit of frequency is Hertz (Hz).
    • The Hertz is the standard unit for measuring the frequency of a wave.
    • One Hertz is equal to one cycle per second.
    • Frequency is the number of occurrences of a repeating event per unit of time.
    • It is also referred to as temporal frequency, which emphasizes the contrast between spatial frequency and angular frequency.
    • Frequency is measured in units of hertz which is equal to one occurrence of a repeating event per second.
    • Formula of Frequency is f = 1/T (f =frequency and T = period).

question: Ugadi is a Telugu festival celebrated on the occasion of _______.
question_hi: उगादी एक तेलुगु त्योहार है, जो _______ के अवसर पर मनाया जाता है।
solution:
The correct answer is Telugu new year.

Key Points

  • Ugadi
    • Ugadi, which is observed as Andhra Pradesh's Hindus' New Year's Day, is observed on the first day of the Hindu Luni-Solar Calendar in the month of Chaitra.
    • According to the Gregorian calendar, it takes place in either March or April.
    • This Indian holiday heralds the arrival of pleasure, joy, hope, and light.
    • The Sanskrit words "Yuga," which means age, and "adi," which means the beginning, are combined to form the word "Ugadi."
    • It denotes the start of a new era in plain terms.
    • In Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana, this holiday is celebrated with great zeal and passion.

Additional Information

  • The ninth month of the Hindu calendar is Agrahya or Mrga.
  • The Hindu month of Vaisakha corresponds to April or May on the Gregorian calendar in the national calendar of India.
  • The fifth month of the Hindu calendar is shravan.

question: Urea is synthesized from amino acids in the _______.
question_hi: यूरिया का संश्लेषण अमीनो अम्ल से _____ में होता है।
solution:
The correct answer is Liver.

Key Points

  • Urea is synthesized from amino acids in the liver.
  • The synthesis of urea in the body is called Urea cycle.
  • The end product of protein and amino acids metabolism in the body is called urea.
    • Ammonium ions are formed in the breakdown of amino acids. Some are used in the biosynthesis of nitrogen compounds and the excess ones are converted into urea.
    • Three amino acids, Ornithine, citrulline and arginine participate in this process. Arginine is decomposed to form urea and ornithine in the presence of enzyme arginase and water. Ornithine can be re-used in the cycle.

Additional Information

  • Excess ammonia is converted into urea. Urea and water get released from the liver cells into the bloodstream and then transported to the kidneys where the blood is filtered and urine is passed out of body.
  • Urine is produced by the kidneys. 

Important Points

  •  The formula of Urea or nitrogenous waste - (NH2CONH2).
solution_hi:
सही उत्‍तर यकृत है।Key Points

  • यकृत में यूरिया का संश्लेषण एमिनो अम्ल से होता है।
  • शरीर में यूरिया का संश्लेषण यूरिया चक्र कहलाता है।
  • शरीर में प्रोटीन और एमिनो अम्ल के उपापचयी का अंतिम उत्पाद यूरिया कहलाता है।
    • एमिनो अम्ल के विघटन से अमोनियम आयन बनते हैं। कुछ का उपयोग नाइट्रोजन यौगिकों के जैवसंश्लेषण में किया जाता है और अतिरिक्त यूरिया में परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं।
    • इस प्रक्रिया में तीन एमिनो अम्ल, ऑर्निथिन, सिट्रूलाइन और आर्जीनिन भाग लेते हैं। आर्जीनिन एंजाइम आर्गिनेज और जल की उपस्थिति में यूरिया और ऑर्निथिन बनाने के लिए विघटित हो जाता है। चक्र में ऑर्निथिन का पुन: उपयोग किया जा सकता है।

Additional Information

  • अतिरिक्त अमोनिया यूरिया में परिवर्तित हो जाता है। यूरिया और जल यकृत की कोशिकाओं से रुधिर में मिल जाते हैं और फिर वृक्क में पहुंच जाते हैं जहां रुधिर निस्यंदित होता है और मूत्र शरीर से बाहर निकल जाता है।
  • मूत्र का निर्माण किडनी द्वारा होता है।

Important Points

  •  यूरिया या नाइट्रोजनी अपशिष्ट का सूत्र (NH2CONH2) है।
